page.notes: The Greek word after "juxta illud" is only partly legible; the accents and final letters are doubtful, so it is marked [?]. "finefin-" in "non finefin-gulari" is doubtful as printed. "negligentiam in magistratus" is a doubtful reading of the line join. The German phrase "Gott richtet, wenn niemand spricht" is set in black letter, and the "f" forms are read as long s. The word "dies" at the foot is the catchword for the next page. No italic type was clearly visible on this page.
